name: parity-mcp-studio
description: MCP Studio — AI runtime, workspace, and observability

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
